prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1144; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for making time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while changing lanes in Sugar Land, Texas. Do you understand that this conversation is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name for the record, and tell me whether you were the driver of your vehicle at the time.

A: I'm the claimant, and yes, I was driving my vehicle.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you remember it, starting from when you decided to change lanes.

A: I was on the right side of a multi-lane road and wanted to move into the left lane to make a turn ahead. I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and signaled. As I started to move over, another car came up on my left and we made contact along the side of my vehicle.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began to move into the lane?

A: I didn't see it in my mirror when I checked. I think it was in my blind spot and came up quickly.

Q: What was the speed of your vehicle and the other vehicle, as best you can estimate?

A: I was going around the speed limit, maybe a little under. I couldn't tell you exactly what the other car was doing.

Q: Were there any witnesses or any police report prepared at the scene?

A: An officer came out and took information. I think he gave me a report number, but I don't have it memorized.

Q: Tell me about your injuries and when you first sought medical care.

A: I fractured my wrist when I grabbed the steering wheel and hit the door. An ambulance took me to the hospital that same day, and I've been in a cast since then. I've had a follow-up with my doctor and I'm still going to physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add or correct about your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and my wrist healed.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
